Description: Ko'z web app on AWS (ap-southeast-2, the project's Region): one small server, one DynamoDB table, one fixed IP, HTTPS. The camera, OpenCV, privacy guard and motors stay on the owner's Mac; only contract JSON events reach AWS. Delete this stack after judging to remove everything.

UbuntuAmi.Description: Canonical's official Ubuntu 24.04 LTS image (leave as it is).

ServerInstanceProfile.Description: The server role's instance profile, made once in the IAM console (docs/AWS_DAY.md): EC2 only, its table and its password.

RepoUrl.Description: The public GitHub repository of Ko'z.

CertEmail.Description: Optional: an email for Let's Encrypt certificate notices. Empty is fine.

Properties.Name: koz-owner-password
Properties.Description: The Ko'z web app owner password (made by AWS, never typed or shown in user data). Read it in Secrets Manager: Retrieve secret value.

Properties.GroupDescription: Koz web: HTTPS (and HTTP for the certificate check) only. No SSH: use Session Manager.

SecurityGroupIngress.Description: Lets Encrypt check and redirect to HTTPS
Dashboard and the runners outbound WebSocket

Fn::Base64.Fn::Sub:
#!/bin/bash
set -eu
exec >>/var/log/koz-install.log 2>&1
# Wait for the Elastic IP first: attaching it changes the address, which would cut a download.
for i in $(seq 1 120); do
  T=$(curl -fsS -X PUT http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token -H 'X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 60' || true)
  [ "$(curl -fsS -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: $T" http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/public-ipv4 || true)" = '${ElasticIp}' ] && break
  sleep 5
done
apt-get update -y
apt-get install -y git
git clone --depth 1 --branch '${RepoRef}' '${RepoUrl}' /opt/koz
bash /opt/koz/deploy/install.sh --ip '${ElasticIp}' --secret '${OwnerPassword}' --region '${AWS::Region}' --table '${Table}' --email '${CertEmail}'

WebUrl.Description: Open this about 10 minutes after the stack is complete.

OwnerPasswordSecret.Description: Secrets Manager -> the secret named koz-owner-password -> Retrieve secret value

InstallLog.Description: If something fails: EC2 -> koz-web -> Connect -> Session Manager -> sudo tail -50 /var/log/koz-install.log
